{
    "ruleKey": "rule.reimbursement.inpatient",
    "ruleName": "住院医保报销规则",
    "ruleText": "package com.his.rules

import com.his.settlement.dto.SettlementFact

rule "住院医保报销规则"
    salience 100
    when
        : SettlementFact(patientType == "INPATIENT")
    then
        .setReimburseAmount(.getTotalFee().multiply(new java.math.BigDecimal("0.75")));
end",
    "category": "reimbursement",
    "description": "住院患者医保报销比例75%",
    "salience": 100
}
